lab.title: Lab samples
lab.subtitle: Collect a sample for a doctor's lab request and hand it to the lab.
lab.rule: A nurse never orders tests on her own authority: you transcribe the doctor's request, then collect and hand over.
lab.newHelp: Enter the doctor and the tests exactly as written. Every test needs its lab catalogue code.
lab.confirmDoctor: I confirm I am transcribing a doctor's request
lab.created: Lab order saved. Collect the sample next.
lab.collectTitle: Collect and hand over the sample
lab.identifiersHelp: Ask the patient and enter at least two. They are compared with the record; wrong-patient samples are the classic lab harm.
lab.consentNote: The patient's consent to share lab orders with a lab is checked automatically. Without it nothing is handed over.
lab.resultReleased: The result was released; open it from the patient's record.
lab.nothingSent: Nothing was sent to the lab.
lab.upgradeHelp: Upgrade your plan to collect samples and hand them to the lab. Everything else keeps working.

LAB_HANDOFF_NO_CONSENT.title: patient has not consented
LAB_HANDOFF_NO_CONSENT.help: Without the patient's consent to share lab orders, nothing can be handed to a lab. Ask the patient to give consent.

CONSENT_REVOKED.title: consent was withdrawn
CONSENT_REVOKED.help: The patient withdrew consent. Do not collect or hand over; ask them to consent again.

TWO_IDENTIFIERS_REQUIRED.title: two identifiers needed
TWO_IDENTIFIERS_REQUIRED.help: Check at least two identifiers, for example full name and date of birth.

IDENTIFIER_MISMATCH.title: identifier does not match
IDENTIFIER_MISMATCH.help: Do not collect. Re-confirm who the patient is before going on.

IDENTIFIER_UNVERIFIABLE.title: cannot be checked
IDENTIFIER_UNVERIFIABLE.help: The record has no value for this identifier. Use a different identifier.

COLLECTED_IN_FUTURE.title: collection time is in the future
COLLECTED_IN_FUTURE.help: Enter the real time the sample was taken.

COLLECTED_TIME_INVALID.title: collection time is not valid
COLLECTED_TIME_INVALID.help: Enter the real time the sample was taken (not too long ago).

HANDOVER_TIME_INVALID.title: hand-over time is not valid
HANDOVER_TIME_INVALID.help: The hand-over cannot be before the collection or in the future.

TEMPERATURE_INVALID.title: temperature is not valid
TEMPERATURE_INVALID.help: Enter the transport temperature in degrees Celsius.

TUBE_REQUIRED.title: no tube recorded
TUBE_REQUIRED.help: Record at least one tube label.

TUBE_LABEL_INVALID.title: tube label is not valid
TUBE_LABEL_INVALID.help: A label is 3-40 printable characters without spaces.

TUBE_LABEL_DUPLICATE.title: duplicate tube label
TUBE_LABEL_DUPLICATE.help: Every tube needs its own unique label, and a label already used cannot be reused.

SPECIMEN_TYPE_REQUIRED.title: specimen type missing
SPECIMEN_TYPE_REQUIRED.help: Choose the specimen type for every tube.

DOCTOR_ORDER_REQUIRED.title: a doctor's request is required
DOCTOR_ORDER_REQUIRED.help: Tick the confirmation that you are transcribing a doctor's request.

PRESCRIBER_REQUIRED.title: doctor and date required
PRESCRIBER_REQUIRED.help: Enter the doctor's name and the date of the request.

ITEM_CODE_REQUIRED.title: test code missing
ITEM_CODE_REQUIRED.help: Every test needs its lab catalogue code and name.

REJECTED_BY_LAB.title: the lab rejected the sample
REJECTED_BY_LAB.help: Contact the lab and the doctor; a new sample may be needed.
